narrative:
Pickaway County has 38,553 registered voters, with 18.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 44.1%, a clear Democratic lean of 11.7 percentage points. Millennials are the largest generational cohort at 27.2% of registrants.
